Report.Name: sr12
Report.sub_report_title: U.S. Feed Grain and Corn Supply and Use 1/
Report.sub_report_footer: Note: Totals may not add due to rounding. 1/ Marketing year beginning September 1 for corn and sorghum; June 1 for barley and oats. 2/ For a breakout of FSI corn uses, see Feed Outlook table 5. 3/ Corn processed in ethanol plants to produce ethanol and by-products including distillers' grains, corn gluten feed, corn gluten meal, and corn oil. 4/ Marketing-year weighted average price received by farmers. * For July, corn planted and harvested area as reported in the June 30, 2026, "Acreage." The yield projection is based on a weather-adjusted trend assuming normal planting progress and summer growing season weather.

Report.Name: sr37
Report.sub_report_title: Reliability of United States October Projections 1/

table4.sub_report_footer: 1/ See pages 35 and 36 for record of reliability for U.S. wheat, rice, soybeans, and cotton. Marketing years 1981/82 through 2025/26 for grains, soybeans, and cotton. Final for grains, soybeans, and cotton is defined as the first November estimate following the marketing year for 1981/82 through 2025/26. Calendar years 1982 through 2025 for meats, eggs, and milk. Final for animal products is defined as the latest annual production estimate published by NASS for 1982-2025. There was no WASDE published in October 2013 or October 2025, due to a partial government shutdown, so no 2013/14 or 2025/26 forecasts in that month were published for grains, soybeans, and cotton, and no 2013 or 2025 forecast was published in that month for animal products.
